test_title: PYST 03: RRB ALP CBT I - Reasoning (Held On: 25 Nov 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A + B means "A is the mother of B"

A - B means "A is the brother of B"

A × B means "A is the wife of B"

A ÷ B means "A is the father of B"

A # B means "A is the daughter of B"

How is P related to K if "Q - S + P - T # R ÷ K"?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 Daughter 
 
 

 

Given: Q - S + P - T # R ÷ K

It means: Q is the brother of S, S is the mother of P, P is the brother of T, T is the daughter of R and R is the father of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/214a1cb02c6ec9360c7e7b2c5b4583736c3a30a5d5b5313c767652fd6ebff295.png] 

So, P is the Brother of K.

Hence, the correct answer is "Brother".
